contexts.text: In order that He might conquer of His Own power...
When evil Spirits are conquered...
That evil and falsity were conquered. Signified, Explained.
If conquered a thousand times, they would still press on...
Although rational good never fights, it always conquers...
Through the combats of temptations He conquered the hereditary...
If the Rational conquers... But if the Natural conquers... (repeated many times).
The temptations in which man conquers... When, therefore, after temptations, he comes into thoughts which are contrary to these, it is a sign that he has not conquered...
The state of temptation when he conquers. Signified.
He who conquers is indeed in doubt... but remains steadfast in the affirmative.
How man yields of himself, but conquers from the Lord. Signified.
Every temptation in which man conquers elevates his mind, for it confirms goods and truths, and superadds new ones.
Hence it is that he conquers...
It is truth which fights and conquers.
Temptation in which he conquers. Signified.
The Lord conquered of His Own power, differently from every man... References.
Naphtali = the quality of the temptation in which he conquers.
When the Spirits who are in evils and falsities are conquered by the Spirits who are in goods and truths...
If he conquers in temptation...
I could not then win...
The good ends conquer, because from the Divine.

It sometimes appears to the Spirits from Hell that they are conquering, and then they rise up; sometimes that they are being conquered, and then they draw themselves back... When they are conquered they cannot come out of Hell any more.
All the spiritual combat in which the combatant is conqueror is attended with this...
When the man conquers, the internal force and power always prevail...
He conquers who believes that the Lord alone resists in temptations...
The reason the Lord alone sustains the combats of temptations, and conquers, is that the Lord alone can conquer the Hells...
He who conquers in temptations is also confirmed in that truth; but he who does not conquer, as he is not heard, entertains doubt concerning the Divine aid and power...
He who once conquers the Hells, perpetually conquers them, for through victory he acquires power over them...
Manna = the good of truth, which is given to those who undergo temptations, and conquer.
That they who are in the truth and good of faith conquer when they look upwards to the Lord, is represented by the Sons of Israel conquering when Moses held up his hands. AC 8605. AC 8606, Explained.
Amalek prevailed = that falsity conquered.
If (in temptation) evil conquers, the natural man has dominion over the spiritual; if good conquers, the spiritual man has dominion over the natural.
To overcome () = to fight from good and truth, for evil is overcome through good, and falsity through truth.
It is the Lord alone Who with man still conquers the Hells; for He Who once conquers them, conquers them to eternity. AC 9937:3.
The truth which fights against evil and falsity, and conquers, must be from good. Explained.
Hence it is that when in temptations man conquers from the Lord, he is drawn out of Hell, and is raised into Heaven.
To him that overcometh () = who fights against evils and falsities, and is being reformed. Illustrated. AR 105, etc. TCR 610.
They shall conquer with themselves the evils which are from Hell. Signified.
He who overcometh () = those who remain steadfast in truths and good from the Lord.
To him that overcometh () = those who are in conjunction with the Lord through a life according to His commandments in the Word.

As I have overcome (id) = that through temptations admitted into His Human, and through the last of them, which was the passion of the cross; also through the fulfilling of all things of the Word, He conquered the Hells and glorified His Human...

He went forth conquering and to conquer () = victory over falsities and evils to eternity... For he who conquers in the world, conquers to eternity, because the Hells cannot attack him who has conquered them.
They seemed to themselves as conquerors. Signified.
To overcome and kill them () = to reject and extirpate them in themselves, and so far as they can, with others.
To make war with the saints, and to overcome them () = that they have assaulted the Divine truths of the Word, and laid them prostrate.
He that overcometh shall inherit all things () = that those who overcome evils with themselves... and do not yield when they are tempted by the Babylonians and the dragonists, will come into Heaven.

If the internal man conquers, he commands and subjugates all the evils of the external man, and then regeneration is continued; but if the external man conquers, he commands, and dissipates all the goods of the [internal] man, and then regeneration perishes.
To overcome () = to receive in the heart. Explained.

To overcome () = to remain in the genuine affection of truth even to the end of the life in the world. It is said he that overcometh, because these are they who undergo spiritual temptation, which is from evils and falsities, and fight against them; to resist which, and master and subdue them as enemies, is to overcome. But no one overcomes unless he remains in the spiritual affection of truth to the end of the life in the world... But no one can overcome except the Lord alone; the man who believes that he overcomes of himself, and not the Lord with him, does not overcome, but yields; for it is spiritual faith which overcomes... AE 197. AE 219. AE 253.
He that overcometh () = those who overcome in temptations.
To overcome () = to fight against the delights of the love of self and of the world, and to remove them.
As I have overcome = as the Divine good is united to the Divine truth.
The lion hath overcome () = the Lord, Who of His Own power has subjugated the Hells, and has reduced all things there and in the Heavens into order.

He went forth conquering and to conquer = the removal of evils and thence of falsities in the end of life, and afterwards to eternity. To conquer, in the Word = to conquer spiritually, which is to subjugate evils and falsities; but as these are no otherwise conquered than as they are removed by the Lord, by to conquer is signified the removal of evils and falsities. Illustrated.
To overcome and kill the two witnesses = the destruction of all the good and truth of the Church.
They overcame him through the blood of the Lamb () = resistance and victory through the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord's Divine Human.
